answer.rationale: p99 latency is climbing on the write path while settlement traffic is at its daily peak and a release went out 2 hours ago. With only one intervention slot, a rollback (memory_b1) is a reasonable option, but rolling back during peak settlement traffic risks losing in-flight writes and customer impact. A circuit breaker (memory_b4) isolates the slow dependency fast, failing fast and preserving the rest of the checkout path. This contains blast radius while we investigate. Verifying memory_b1 (rollback cleared checkout spike) and memory_b4 (circuit breakers contained partner outage) to confirm the historical shape of these interventions before committing.
